create.name: Raphael Cushnir
create.bio:
Raphael Cushnir came to teaching after a first career in Los Angeles as a screenwriter, film director and media campaigner for environmental and human-rights causes. When his work and marriage both collapsed in the mid-1990s, a mentor encouraged him to stay with the pain rather than flee it, and that period became the start of his own spiritual waking up and, later, of his life's work.

He calls his approach Emotional Connection: a simple way of turning towards whatever feeling is present, letting it be fully felt in the body and allowing it to move, so that presence becomes possible even in hard moments. He has written six books, among them Unconditional Bliss, Setting Your Heart on Fire, How Now and The One Thing Holding You Back, plus a guided journal for couples, and his articles have appeared in O, The Oprah Magazine and Spirituality and Health. He has led workshops as a faculty member at Esalen, Kripalu and Omega, offers private sessions for individuals and couples by phone or video on a sliding scale, and trains coaches and other practitioners to use the Emotional Connection process with their own clients.

books.title: The One Thing Holding You Back: Unleashing the Power of Emotional Connection
books.author: Raphael Cushnir
books.description: His fullest account of the Emotional Connection process, a short practice for meeting difficult feelings directly instead of avoiding them. Case stories show how the same approach applies at home and at work.

books.title: Setting Your Heart on Fire: Seven Invitations to Liberate Your Life
books.author: Raphael Cushnir
books.description: Seven invitations, taken one at a time, for opening a closed heart and living with more freedom. Each chapter pairs reflection with simple exercises.

books.title: Unconditional Bliss: Finding Happiness in the Face of Hardship
books.author: Raphael Cushnir
books.description: His first book, drawn from his own period of loss, introduces a way of meeting hard times by living the questions they raise rather than rushing to answers.

books.title: How Now: 100 Ways to Celebrate the Present Moment
books.author: Raphael Cushnir
books.description: A small illustrated gift book of one hundred brief suggestions for coming back to the present, written in a light, accessible style.

books.title: Surfing Your Inner Sea: Essential Lessons for Lasting Serenity
books.author: Raphael Cushnir
books.description: Short reflections that draw lessons about calm and presence from everyday events, from the end of a marriage to a child's card game.

books.title: Back to Us: A Couple's Journal of Reconnection and Growth
books.author: Raphael Cushnir
books.description: A guided journal for two, with prompts that partners answer separately and then share, for couples at any stage of a long relationship.

courses.title: Private Sessions with Raphael
courses.description: One-hour individual sessions or ninety-minute couples sessions by phone or Zoom, working with the Emotional Connection process. Sessions can be one-off or regular, and the fee is chosen by the client on a sliding scale.

courses.title: Emotional Connection Facilitator Certification
courses.description: A one-to-one distance training for coaches and other practitioners who want to use his method with clients. Trainees read his book, take three clients through supervised sessions and can finish within six months.

free_resources.title: Free Materials
free_resources.description: A gathering page for his free introductions to Emotional Connection: book chapters, magazine articles, recorded sessions, a television interview and blog posts.
